scripts.dev: PORT=3001 pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server dev & PORT=3000 VITE_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3001 pnpm --filter @workspace/skillfit dev
scripts.build: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --if-present run build
scripts.start: PORT=3001 pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server start & PORT=3000 VITE_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3001 pnpm --filter @workspace/skillfit serve
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
